map.池塘最大养殖容量与放养尾数计算，含多模式参考: Estimate the carrying capacity of a pond from volume, oxygen and species.
map.📖 查看「池塘最大载鱼量（承鱼量）估算使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pond Carrying Capacity Estimation Guide"
map.承鱼量 = f(面积, 溶氧, 换水): Carrying capacity = f(area, dissolved oxygen, water exchange)
map.水体体积 = 池塘面积 × 666.67 m²/亩 × 水深: Water volume = pond area × 666.67 m²/mu × water depth
map.最大载鱼量 = 水体体积 × 单位水体产量: Maximum carrying capacity = water volume × yield per unit volume
map.推荐放养尾数 = (最大载鱼量 × 1000) ÷ 目标规格 ÷ 成活率: Recommended stocking count = (maximum carrying capacity × 1000) ÷ target size ÷ survival rate
map.推荐放养密度 = 放养尾数 ÷ 池塘面积 (尾/亩): Recommended stocking density = stocking count ÷ pond area (fish/mu)
map.粗养 200-400 kg/亩；半精养 500-800 kg/亩；精养 1000: Extensive 200-400 kg/mu; semi-intensive 500-800 kg/mu; intensive 1000-1500 kg/mu; high density 1500-2500+ kg/mu (needs aerators plus water exchange).
map.不投喂或少量投喂，靠天然饵料: No or little feeding, relying on natural food
map.人工投喂，定期换水: Artificial feeding with regular water exchange
map.增氧机、人工投喂、水质监测: Aerators, artificial feeding and water-quality monitoring
map.多台增氧机、循环水、连续监测: Multiple aerators, recirculating water and continuous monitoring
map.🐟 常见鱼种目标上市规格参考: 🐟 Target Market Sizes for Common Species
map.📚 深度解析：池塘最大载鱼量（承鱼量）估算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Pond Carrying Capacity Estimation
map.放苗前按面积、水深与养殖模式（粗养/半精养/精养/高密度）估算池塘可承载的最大生: Before stocking, estimate the maximum biomass the pond can carry from area, depth and farming mode (extensive / semi-intensive / intensive / high density) to avoid overloading.
map.设定目标上市规格与成活率，反推应放养的尾数，指导苗种采购。: Set the target market size and survival rate to back-calculate the number of fish to stock, guiding fry purchase.
map.高密度模式（>2.5 kg/m³）评估增氧、备电与水质的配套需求。: For high-density modes (>2.5 kg/m³), assess the needs for aeration, backup power and water quality.
map.5 亩、水深 1.5 m、半精养、目标 1000 g/尾、成活率 90%: 5 mu, 1.5 m deep, semi-intensive, target 1000 g per fish, survival rate 90%
map.默认参数下：水体体积 = 5×666.67×1.5 ≈ 5000 m³；半精养单: With the default parameters: water volume = 5×666.67×1.5 ≈ 5000 m³; at a semi-intensive unit yield of 0.8 kg/m³ the maximum carrying capacity is ≈ 4000 kg; the per-mu yield is ≈ 800 kg/mu; at a 90% survival rate the recommended stocking count is ≈ 4000×1000/(1000×0.9) ≈ 4444 fish,
map.单位产量（kg/m³）怎么取？: How should the unit yield (kg/m³) be chosen?
map.粗养约 0.3、半精养 0.8、精养 1.5、高密度 3.0 kg/m³，是经验: About 0.3 for extensive, 0.8 for semi-intensive, 1.5 for intensive and 3.0 kg/m³ for high density; these are empirical carrying densities, limited in practice by aeration and water-exchange capacity.
map.载鱼量上限由水体容量和增氧能力共同决定，超出增氧能力的高密度极易缺氧泛塘。: The carrying-capacity limit is set jointly by water volume and aeration capacity; a high density beyond the aeration capacity is very prone to oxygen depletion and pond die-off.
